column4: Visit note | 2026-01-24 09:30 AM | Dr. Fahmida Yasmin, ENT | Patient: Hafsa Siddique, 41, female. Mrs. Siddique comes in for a review of her allergic rhinitis, reporting that her symptoms are still worse with dust and that she suffers from frequent sneezing fits and a runny nose. She works as a garment factory worker and mentions her condition has been worse since keeping a cat at home in Lalbagh. She reports about 7 sneezing fits a day. She denies any fever, ear pain, or breathing difficulties. On examination: about 7 sneezing fits a day, BP 126/74 mmHg, pulse 70 bpm, weight 94 kg. The nasal mucosa appears pale and boggy, with clear secretions, and the throat is clear. Assessment: Allergic rhinitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to avoid dust, wear a mask when cleaning, and wash bedding weekly. Follow-up in 1 month.
